access_links.label: Zenodo landing page and file inventory

description: The ENCORE project publishes nine XML workplans automatically generated by Automated Work Planning Services during a renovation test. The Zenodo file inventory covers plan days from 7 March to 7 April 2022 and labels the deposit CC BY 4.0. These dated plans could serve as outputs for comparing a new crew-assignment or construction-scheduling simulation with the project workflow. They are generated plans, not proof that every planned task was carried out. Separate ENCORE deposits contain crew effort and observed building progress, which would be needed to evaluate schedule accuracy. The landing page does not state the XML schema, objective function, resource constraints or plan-to-activity join keys. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this nine-plan set. The XML files were not downloaded or executed, so structural validity, task counts and any relationship to actual completion are unverified.
name: Workplans generated during AWOPS tests
notes: G6 item G6-2290. Metadata-only draft. Simulation-use and type tags are reviewer classifications. File contents and software execution were not checked. Unknown maturity does not assert active maintenance.
